Arthur stared out across the churning gray swell, where forty years of shipwrecks had vanished without a trace, wondering who had thrown the glass into the surf, and how many tides had passed since the sea had answered.", "w02": "凌晨四点整，整座城市沉入一种幽蓝而稀薄的静谧之中。高架桥如灰白色的巨蟒盘踞在楼宇之间，偶尔有一辆洒水车泛着微光掠过，留下湿漉漉的水痕与低沉的轰鸣。便利店的白炽灯箱孤独地刺破黑暗，环卫工人的扫帚摩擦着柏油路面，一下一下唤醒街巷的轮廓。雾气尚未散去，这是城市在白昼苏醒前最诚实的呼吸。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a rule or task solves a big puzzle by repeating itself on smaller and smaller pieces.\n- Think of it like opening a Russian nesting doll: each doll contains a tiny twin doing the exact same thing.\n- It only stops when you reach the very last, smallest piece—called the base case—which tells the whole chain to finish."}
